  • Method Details

    • build

      public SkilledReactSubAgent build(CompileConfig compileConfig, SkillSource skillSource) throws Exception
      Builds a skill-backed React sub-agent from the provided skill source.

      The skill front matter must define at least the name and description properties. When allowed-tools is present, the current tool set is filtered before compiling the sub-agent.

      Parameters:
      compileConfig - the compile configuration to use, or null to use defaults
      skillSource - the source used to load the skill markdown definition
      Returns:
      a configured SkilledReactSubAgent
      Throws:
      Exception - if the skill cannot be loaded or the agent cannot be built
